reason: PURE. First thing I noticed was 'no magnesium oxide' and the QR for the batch report, which is what I check anyway; 200 mg elemental per sachet is a real dose and $29.99 is fair for chelated. I'd buy one box of the bisglycinate to try, not the 3-form one, since 207 mg split across three forms is a thin amount of each.
objection: I have a drawer of half-used bottles, so I need to see the QR report is a real named lab with real numbers for that batch, not just a link that says 'tested'. Also sachets are pricier per mg than a bottle.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR report did not open a real batch result with the lab name and magnesium content, I would not reorder.
